dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: Well, here's a turn up for the books! Fancy seeing you in Nod-Krai... It looks like your command skills have improved since the last time we met.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: You're too modest. Ever since I got my hands on the standard-issue wargame from the Maison Gardiennage, I've been racking my brains trying to find ways to make it more three-dimensional...

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Captain Grosrochard once told me, "Some fighters are just like wolves — not only are their teeth sharp, but they know exactly where to bite."

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Proto-Boss, I think you're exactly the sort of wolf the captain was talking about! Even my improved wargame won't fully test your talents — you're just too good at knowing what to do.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: ...But watching someone as skilled as Wislawa having to pause and puzzle things out makes me think my changes have been a wonderful success!

choices.text: So, is she your latest fugitive suspect?

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Ha! That's just a coincidence. She has nothing to do with anyone I'm after.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: I met her in Fontaine, and we didn't exactly hit it off... I thought she was a kidnapper and subdued her on the spot. It turned out I made a mistake.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: She saved the little girl who was kidnapped — but how was I to know? A tall foreigner turning up in the middle of nowhere disguised as a local and carrying a musket...

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Ahem, anyway, the point is we worked it all out. Still, she appears to be very dangerous — and suspicious.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: So, in the interests of safety, I told her I was a kind-hearted merchant. I'm pretty sure she's not really a bodyguard...

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: And running into her here, it seems her identity is even more mysterious than I first thought.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wow, impressive moves.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Luck's a fickle thing. Recently, our kind-hearted bodyguard has put the brakes on this "suspicious merchant"...

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Fortunately, she seems more interested in fighting me than in figuring out my background. That's one of the few things going my way right now!

choices.text: Is our "kind-hearted merchant" trying to catch this "kind-hearted bodyguard"?
There are still a few features I don't understand...

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: But don't worry, every battle has its twists and turns, and so does every wargame! No one can predict each little change of fortune.

choices.text: You're making me blush. It's time to do some damage!

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: I'll leave you to it then! Be sure to thoroughly enjoy the new wargame!

dialogues.speaker: Edler
dialogues.text: Hello! I'm supposed to be shipping out, but I'm finding myself oddly reluctant to leave Nod-Krai.

choices.text: I want to play another wargame!

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Sure thing, feel free.

choices.text: It's the sort of place you can feel right at home.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Exactly. And if I run into someone who doesn't know what's good for them, well...

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: However you look at it, I've learned a lot — I've even got some ideas for how to improve my wargame further. Next time I see you, you'll be able to try out the doubly improved, latest, most recent, contemporary, up-to-date version.

choices.text: Or are you oddly reluctant to leave Wislawa?

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Her? Of course not! I want to get as far away from her as possible — she's dangerous and always finding fault. I hope I never see her again.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: Well, maybe that's not fair... If I do see her again, I'd like to have a proper spar with her to decide once and for all who's stronger.

response.speaker: Edler
response.text: That way, she might be able to get the idea of sparring out of her head for good.
